ABOUT US

Honouring the Wisdom of the Ancestors

Luo Ancestral Covenant is an ancestral and traditional knowledge institution founded on the sacred wisdom of the Luo ancestors. Our mission is to preserve, protect and share indigenous African knowledge while providing cultural guidance, ancestral education and traditional herbal practices.

Although our ancestral guardians and traditional lineage originate from the Luo community of Kenya, our calling is not limited to Luo people alone. We welcome individuals and families from every part of the world.

Read Our Full Story →
“Though our roots are Luo, our service is for all humanity.”
✦

Our Philosophy

✦

We believe every human being is born into a lineage carrying its own ancestral heritage. We do not assume one ancestral tradition fits everyone. Instead, our work begins by respectfully seeking understanding of each person's ancestral background.

01

Every Family Has a Story

Family history and ancestral identity deserve to be remembered and respected.

02

Every Culture Deserves Respect

Traditions differ, and that difference is part of humanity's cultural richness.

03

Guidance Begins With Understanding

We seek context before offering cultural direction according to our traditional approach.

MEET THE PRACTITIONER

About Juogi Wuoyo

Juogi Wuoyo is an ancestral practitioner, cultural educator and traditional herbal practitioner devoted to preserving indigenous African wisdom and ancestral heritage.

His work combines ancestral education, traditional herbal knowledge, cultural mentorship and community service while promoting respect for every person's ancestral identity.
